podcast.body: This song's music video won the MTV Music Video Award in 1994, beating out the Beastie Boys' "Sabotage" video, which led to Adam Yauch's onstage protest as Nathaniel Hornblower. "the Sabotage clip lost out to R.E.M.'s Everybody Hurts."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: The music video for "Everybody Hurts," directed by Jake Scott, was filmed around an interchange where Interstate 10 meets Interstate 35 in San Antonio, Texas. The video depicts the band stuck in a traffic jam, with subtitles displaying the thoughts of other people in the same predicament, before everyone vanishes except for Michael Stipe at the end. Film students might notice similarities to Federico Fellini's 1963 art film *Eight and a Half*. "If you're a student of film, you might have been struck by the similarities to Frederico Felini's 1963 art film Eight and a Half."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
